# PiTTy v0.6.63

- **Subagents:** Read turn counts, executed tools and context usage directly from pi-subagent >=0.5.16 status. Stop claiming a child is `starting…` when it is already active but usage is unavailable.
- **Less file I/O:** Bounded compatibility reader for older children and bounded transcript tails. No full-child-session read for live child usage.
- **Maintainability:** Session, input, compaction, and extension-status controllers separated from OpenTUI rendering. See `docs/architecture-services.md`.
- **Compatibility:** Older pi-subagent versions remain supported, with a bounded fallback for their old status. No new Pi runtime requirement.

Local verification: 711 tests passed, 1 skipped, 0 failed, TypeScript and runtime build passed. Cross-platform CI also validates this release.

Upgrade with `pitty upgrade --version 0.6.63`, and update `git:github.com/mistrjirka/pi-subagent` to v0.5.16 when safe to restart child processes.
